title: ci(release): add artifact signing, SLSA provenance generation, and release manifests for private-installer artifacts
author: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Introduce end-to-end release automation for redwood-private-installer artifacts targeted at air-gapped/VPC customers. This PR adds build-time artifact signing (cosign), SLSA provenance generation/attestation, and a machine-readable release manifest consumed by installer automation and Terraform modules. Motivation: customers and SOC teams require cryptographic guarantees for installer binaries and Helm charts for offline installs; release manifests make upgrades/rollbacks deterministic for private deployments. What changed: 1) CI pipeline (GH Actions) additions: new workflow release/provenance.yml that builds installer bundles, invokes cosign to sign images and tarballs using a KMS-backed key (integration via repo-level secrets and a short-lived service account), produces in-toto-style SLSA provenance attestations, and uploads signed artifacts and attestations to the release bucket. 2) Release manifest: new artifacts/release-manifests/<version>.json template generated by the workflow containing artifact URLs, checksums, cosign signatures and provenance links. 3) Installer verification helpers: small scripts in tools/verifier that validate cosign signatures and verify provenance with in-toto. 4) Helm index and chart packaging updates: job packages charts, signs archive, and lists signatures in the manifest. 5) Terraform module metadata: module/metadata.tf updated to consume manifest URL for deterministic module sources in private installs. 6) Docs: docs/private/release-provenance.md describing verification steps for customers and SRE. Checklist: [x] CI build + sign + attest workflow added | [x] cosign integration with KMS-secret rotation documented | [x] release manifest schema defined and backwards-compatible | [x] installer verification scripts included and unit-tested | [x] Helm chart signing included | [x] unit/integration tests for workflow (local runner) | [x] docs updated. Security notes: signing keys are stored in the org KMS and only exposed to the actions runner via short-lived tokens; cosign attestation is produced with predicate that includes build env and commit SHA to reduce replay risk. Backwards compatibility: manifest schema v1 is opt-in; older installer versions ignore unknown fields. Rollback story: release manifests include previous-version pointers to allow deterministic rollback. Related: ENG-4782 (release automation), ENG-4790 (private-installer hardening). Migration: existing releases will be re-published with manifest entries where possible. Testing: added unit tests for verifier and e2e smoke run on a staging bucket. Notes on failure modes: CI will block merge on missing signatures or mismatched checksums; manual emergency bypass requires an org-level approval workflow.
